title: Transformer Toxicity and Identity Classifier
summary: A bidirectional Transformer encoder is trained from scratch on GPT-2 BPE tokenized comments, truncated to 256 tokens. It uses token and positional embeddings, six pre-layer-normalized self-attention/MLP blocks, padding-aware attention, and concatenated masked mean and max pooling. A linear head predicts a toxicity target plus one auxiliary logit per identity label. Text tokens are cached in flattened arrays; batches are shuffled, length-sorted within chunks, dynamically padded, and then shuffled again. Training uses four epochs of mixed-precision AdamW with decoupled weight decay excluding positional embeddings and low-dimensional parameters, linear learning-rate warmup followed by cosine decay, and gradient-norm clipping. The loss is per-output BCE-with-logits, averaged over examples and weighted as 1 for toxicity and total weight 0.5 distributed across identity outputs. Inference length-sorts validation examples, batches them, and returns sigmoid probabilities from the toxicity logit.
